evidence_boundary: Isolated temporary synthetic package bytes and synthetic signature-status metadata only. These checks establish filename/set rejection, hash association and manifest behavior; they do not establish real Authenticode or Android signatures, installer execution, device acceptance, or a remote GitHub Actions run.
